newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher on stock rally.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher on stock rally.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed higher on Monday amid tightened liquidity as yet another seven-year high close in the stock market intensified an exodus of funds into the red-hot bourse, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate finished at 6.761 percent against Saturday's 6.609 close -- outside the central bank's 5.0-5.5 percent target zone but far below the record double-digit closes of late June.
The 30-day commercial paper was at 6.75-6.85 percent against 6.35-6.50.
The stock index on Monday closed 53.80 points or 0.55 percent higher at 9,923.05, its highest finish since April April 12, 1990. Turnover was a heavy T$196 billion.
The bond market saw slow trade, with the 10-year 86/4 bond yield at 6.0450 percent against Saturday's 5.998 close.
